llm_verdict.message:
The **net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_ra** kernel parameter has been disabled and persisted.

**Actions performed**
1. Created `/etc/sysctl.d/99-disable-accept_ra.conf` (mode 0644) with:
   ```
   net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_ra = 0
   ```
2. Applied the setting immediately:
   ```
   sysctl -w net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_ra=0
   ```
3. Reloaded all sysctl configuration files:
   ```
   sysctl --system
   ```

This resolves the OpenSCAP finding **sysctl_net_ipv6_conf_all_accept_ra** by ensuring router advertisements are disabled on all IPv6 interfaces, both at runtime and across reboots. No other system components were altered.
